sources.title: inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-fp8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Introduction We are introducing Ling-3.0-tiny, a lightweight hybrid reasoning MoE model with 7.9B total parameters and only 1.3B activated parameters per token. It is designed to deliver strong reasoning and agentic capabilities under a small inference compute footprint, making advanced model capabilities more accessible for local and resource-constrained deployment. sources.snippet: Ling is a MoE LLM provided and open-sourced by InclusionAI. We introduce two different sizes, which are Ling-lite and Ling-plus. Ling-lite has 16.8 billion parameters with 2.75 billion activated parameters, while Ling-plus has 290 billion parameters with 28.8 billion activated parameters. sources.snippet: Ling 3.0 Tiny is InclusionAI's compact Mixture-of-Experts language model for responsive agents, instruction following, multi-turn conversation, and switchable thinking or instant response modes.
